jobs.title: Senior Program Manager
jobs.description_text: Our team, composed of diverse employees with a wide range of backgrounds and experiences, is passionate about solving challenging problems. PathAI is looking for a skilled and experienced individual to join the Program Management Office (PMO) and help support the execution of PathAI’s key product development initiatives. The PMO works closely with cross functional representatives, including Product Management and technical teams, to formulate and manage timelines/resources/budgets, log and record risks and actions - and most importantly drive key results within the business. This is a critical role within PathAI. It is an opportunity to work in a company where patients come first. The Opportunity You will partner with senior leadership in the PMO and cross-functional technical experts, to help deliver the company’s most complex Product Development Programs You will create project plans, run cross-functional team meetings, report outputs to internal stakeholders You will resolve issues by bringing the right people together, drive towards decisions and fully document everything along the way (minutes, decision logs, project risks) You will manage multiple medium-to-large sized projects independently with responsibility for maintaining budgets, timelines, reporting, and documentation. You will recommend new ways of working within the organization, with a strong focus on efficiency and delivery. You will simplify complex situations, stay calm under pressure, and lead by example.

jobs.description_text: PathAI is transforming traditional pathology methods into powerful, new technologies. We are seeking a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to join our Engineering team. In this position, you will help build and maintain the automated testing infrastructure that underpins the reliability of PathAI's software platform. You will partner closely with software engineers, product managers, and QA leads to design test strategies, write automation code, review pull requests, and debug complex failures — all in service of delivering software that clinicians and patients can depend on. In addition, you will actively contribute to expanding and optimizing our testing infrastructure. As PathAI's platform grows, so does the complexity of our testing needs — you will help scale our automation capabilities by contributing to test environments, cloud infrastructure, and the deployment pipelines that keep quality high across multiple services and teams. This includes hands-on work with AWS and Kubernetes to provision, manage, and observe test environments, and a focus on making our toolset faster, more reliable, and easier for the whole engineering team to use. This is an excellent opportunity for someone early in their SDET career who is eager to learn, grow quickly, and make a real impact in healthcare technology. jobs.description_text: PathAI is looking for an experienced, strategic Staff AI Product Manager to help shape and execute our core product roadmap. As a Staff PM, you will serve as a strategic leader and cross-functional connector, partnering closely with machine learning, pathology, biomedical data science, clinical affairs, quality, regulatory, and business operations teams. This role offers a high-visibility opportunity to lead zero-to-one product initiatives and scale existing algorithm portfolios in a fast-growing, dynamic health-tech environment. The Opportunity: Drive Strategic AI Product Vision: Define and execute the multi-year product strategy and roadmap for PathAI algorithm products within a key business unit or disease area (e.g., oncology). Lead End-to-End Product Lifecycle: Conduct product explorations, build business cases, define requirements, oversee prototyping, and lead the cross-functional deployment of new AI products and product line extensions. Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner closely with AI/ML engineers, data scientists, clinical specialists, product designers, and pathologists to translate complex algorithmic discoveries into scalable, user-centric clinical and research tools. jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, BioPharma Platforms
jobs.description_text: As a Staff Product Manager, Biopharma Platforms, you will shape and drive the core digital platforms that power clinical development and translational research pipelines. In this high-impact strategic role, you will bridge cutting-edge cloud software engineering, clinical trials, machine learning, and clinical research, transforming clinical workflows into seamless, scalable platform capabilities. You will champion platform product thinking across PathAI, ensuring our engineering and clinical teams and biopharma partners can discover, develop, and deliver transformative therapies with unprecedented velocity.
